ATEC Spine is committed to Revolutionizing the Approach to Spine Surgery.

[ About Us ][67]

# Valence^{®}: Purpose-built for spine surgery

Valence unifies navigation and robotics into a seamless platform designed to advance ATEC’s
procedures. Featuring a surgeon-controlled in-field camera, intentionally designed software, and a
comprehensive suite of navigated instruments, Valence delivers clarity and control at every step of
the procedure.

## ATEC Spine Latest News

[ATEC_Q1 26 Social Post_043026]

### ATEC Reports First Quarter Financial Results

May 5, 2026
* Surgical revenue grew 17%; total revenue grew 14%
* Net new surgeon users increased 23% year over year, reinforcing durable growth
* Adjusted EBITDA of $21 million, or 11% of revenue, expanded 460 basis points year over year
* Company announces refinancing of existing debt with inaugural bank facility, reducing interest
  expense by more than $6 million annually and extending maturities to 2031

[ VIEW PRESS RELEASE ][96]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_March]

### March Society Meeting Highlights

April 3, 2026

March was defined by continued momentum in surgeon education and collaboration, with ATEC
participating in key society meetings and regional symposia across the country. Each event provided
an opportunity to engage with surgeons, share procedural insights, and highlight innovations
designed to support better surgical decision-making and patient outcomes.

[ VIEW FULL ARTICLE ][97]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_Feb]

### February Society Meeting Highlights

March 9, 2026

February reflected the global momentum behind surgeon-driven education and data-informed spine care.
From deformity-focused collaboration in Asia Pacific to high-level cranial and spine discussions at
Winter Clinics and innovation in lateral surgery at Spine Summit, each meeting reinforced a shared
priority: advancing precision through planning, technology integration, and procedural discipline.

### ATEC Reports First Quarter Financial Results

May 5, 2026
* Surgical revenue grew 17%; total revenue grew 14%
* Net new surgeon users increased 23% year over year, reinforcing durable growth
* Adjusted EBITDA of $21 million, or 11% of revenue, expanded 460 basis points year over year
* Company announces refinancing of existing debt with inaugural bank facility, reducing interest
  expense by more than $6 million annually and extending maturities to 2031

[ VIEW PRESS RELEASE ][96]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_March]

### March Society Meeting Highlights

April 3, 2026

March was defined by continued momentum in surgeon education and collaboration, with ATEC
participating in key society meetings and regional symposia across the country. Each event provided
an opportunity to engage with surgeons, share procedural insights, and highlight innovations
designed to support better surgical decision-making and patient outcomes.

### February Society Meeting Highlights

March 9, 2026

February reflected the global momentum behind surgeon-driven education and data-informed spine care.
From deformity-focused collaboration in Asia Pacific to high-level cranial and spine discussions at
Winter Clinics and innovation in lateral surgery at Spine Summit, each meeting reinforced a shared
priority: advancing precision through planning, technology integration, and procedural discipline.

# Life moves us.

We know that what we do today changes lives tomorrow. We actively listen to the needs of surgeons
and patients, and we innovate with passion. We solve unmet clinical needs and deliver procedurally
integrated solutions paired with leading-edge enabling technologies to improve patient care.

[About Globus Medical][137]

# Life moves us.

We know that what we do today changes lives tomorrow. We actively listen to the needs of surgeons
and patients, and we innovate with passion. We solve unmet clinical needs and deliver procedurally
integrated solutions paired with leading-edge enabling technologies to improve patient care.

[About Globus Medical][138]
[Icon showing two people]

### PATIENTS & CAREGIVERS

Find information on musculoskeletal conditions and treatment options that can help you make educated
decisions alongside your care team.

[Learn More][139]
[Icon showing a doctor]

### HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS

Discover our comprehensive portfolio of procedures and enabling technologies, clinical education
programs, and additional resources for healthcare professionals.

[Learn More][140]
[Icon showing a hand holding a plant]

### INVESTORS

Explore the latest news, financial, stock, and Company information for the investor community.

[Learn More][141]
[previous arrow]
Excelsius Technology

### Featured Technology

## Excelsius™ Technology

Excelsius™ Technology is an ecosystem of advanced technology designed to improve safety and care in
the OR for patients and hospital staff. The intelligent features that define each of these platforms
are designed to provide extraordinary care and change the way surgery is done.

[
Learn more
][142]
[Excelsius Technology devices]
TLIF

### Featured Technology

## TLIF

Our TLIF portfolio is designed to provide the ability to reproduce workflows from open to minimally
invasive (MIS) approaches. Our comprehensive portfolio offers access paired with disc prep, a suite
of interbody spacers designed for sagittal alignment and fusion, and versatile fixation systems and
enabling technologies to accommodate various techniques.

[
Learn more
][143]
[CREO MIS with ALTERA]
XLIF

### Featured Technology

## XLIF™

Built on 20 years of procedural experience, XLIF™ continues to define the standard of care for
minimally invasive spine surgery through its rote surgical technique and procedurally integrated
portfolio of technologies.

[
Learn more
][144]
[Retractor]
Expandable Technology

### Featured Technology

## Expandable Technology

As pioneers of expandable technology and through continued insight from clinical experts, we have
developed an industry-leading portfolio of expandable interbody spacers designed for use in a wide
variety of interbody fusion procedures.

[
Learn more
][145]
[Expandable spacers]
Advanced Materials Science

### Featured Technology

## Advanced Materials Science™

Adhering to the three core principles of Advanced Materials Science™—surface, structure and
imaging—we have pioneered design and manufacturing methods that combine the benefits of porosity
with the advantageous material properties of PEEK and titanium.

[
Learn more
][146]
[Advanced Materials Science spacers]
Power Portfolio

### Featured Technology

## Power Portfolio

Our power portfolio drives efficiency at every level and helps safeguard critical and delicate
patient anatomy through navigation and innovative technology. Verzera™ and DuraPro™ are engineered
to seamlessly integrate with Excelsius™ Technology to streamline surgical workflows and address
clinical challenges.

[
Learn more
][147]
[Globus power tools]
Precice

### Featured Technology

## Precice™

Precice™ is a proprietary magnetically adjustable technology for limb reconstruction that allows for
real-time adjustment at the time of implantation and throughout the course of treatment to
accommodate the clinical needs of patients as they heal and grow.

[
Learn more
][148]
[Precice]
Simplify

### Featured Technology

## Simplify™

Simplify™ Cervical Disc is designed to treat conditions associated with cervical disc degeneration
while offering surgeons exceptional capabilities for cTDR across key performance functions—anatomy,
physiologic motion, and radiologic design.

[
Learn more
][149]
[Simplify]
[next arrow]

## Best-in-Class Surgeon Training

By using modern education principles, a highly personalized curriculum, and multi-modal learning
pathways paired with leading-edge enabling technologies, the MERC team and its dedicated surgeon
faculty provide an outstanding learning experience for surgeons and their staff around the globe.

[Continue your education today][150]
[Surgeons]

### Featured Technology

## Excelsius™ Technology

Excelsius™ Technology is an ecosystem of advanced technology designed to improve safety and care in
the OR for patients and hospital staff. The intelligent features that define each of these platforms
are designed to provide extraordinary care and change the way surgery is done.

[
Learn more
][142]
[Excelsius Technology devices]
TLIF

### Featured Technology

## TLIF

Our TLIF portfolio is designed to provide the ability to reproduce workflows from open to minimally
invasive (MIS) approaches. Our comprehensive portfolio offers access paired with disc prep, a suite
of interbody spacers designed for sagittal alignment and fusion, and versatile fixation systems and
enabling technologies to accommodate various techniques.

[
Learn more
][143]

XLIF

### Featured Technology

## XLIF™

Built on 20 years of procedural experience, XLIF™ continues to define the standard of care for
minimally invasive spine surgery through its rote surgical technique and procedurally integrated
portfolio of technologies.

[
Learn more
][144]

### Featured Technology

## Expandable Technology

As pioneers of expandable technology and through continued insight from clinical experts, we have
developed an industry-leading portfolio of expandable interbody spacers designed for use in a wide
variety of interbody fusion procedures.

[
Learn more
][145]
[Expandable spacers]
Advanced Materials Science

### Featured Technology

## Advanced Materials Science™

Adhering to the three core principles of Advanced Materials Science™—surface, structure and
imaging—we have pioneered design and manufacturing methods that combine the benefits of porosity
with the advantageous material properties of PEEK and titanium.

[
Learn more
][146]

### Featured Technology

## Power Portfolio

Our power portfolio drives efficiency at every level and helps safeguard critical and delicate
patient anatomy through navigation and innovative technology. Verzera™ and DuraPro™ are engineered
to seamlessly integrate with Excelsius™ Technology to streamline surgical workflows and address
clinical challenges.

[
Learn more
][147]

### Featured Technology

## Precice™

Precice™ is a proprietary magnetically adjustable technology for limb reconstruction that allows for
real-time adjustment at the time of implantation and throughout the course of treatment to
accommodate the clinical needs of patients as they heal and grow.

[
Learn more

Simplify™ Cervical Disc is designed to treat conditions associated with cervical disc degeneration
while offering surgeons exceptional capabilities for cTDR across key performance functions—anatomy,
physiologic motion, and radiologic design.

Learn more

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## [Spinal Solutions][77]

Orthofix’s complete spine portfolio provides reconstructive and regenerative solutions that aim to
restore the quality of life for patients with various spinal and bone-related conditions. Our
innovative solutions uniquely incorporate different treatment modalities (mechanical, biological and
electromagnetic) to achieve desired clinical outcomes. Our goal is to help patients maintain their
range of motion or achieve successful spinal fusions.

## [Limb Reconstruction][81]

Orthofix is an industry leader with a unique portfolio of limb reconstruction solutions, addressing
the most challenging congenital, developmental, and acquired orthopedic conditions in patients of
all ages.

continuous innovation of hardware and enabling technologies, clinical evidence and industry-leading
medical education programs.

## Medical Devices & Solutions

[Spine Solutions - Spine Procedures]

## [Spinal Solutions][77]

Orthofix’s complete spine portfolio provides reconstructive and regenerative solutions that aim to
restore the quality of life for patients with various spinal and bone-related conditions. Our
innovative solutions uniquely incorporate different treatment modalities (mechanical, biological and
electromagnetic) to achieve desired clinical outcomes. Our goal is to help patients maintain their
range of motion or achieve successful spinal fusions.

[Spinal Solutions][78]  | [Biologics][79]  |  [Spinal Fusion Therapy][80]

[Orthopedic]

## [Limb Reconstruction][81]

Orthofix is an industry leader with a unique portfolio of limb reconstruction solutions, addressing
the most challenging congenital, developmental, and acquired orthopedic conditions in patients of
all ages.

We remain focused on the complete patient pathway, supporting clinicians and patients through
continuous innovation of hardware and enabling technologies, clinical evidence and industry-leading
medical education programs.

[Limb Reconstruction][82]  |  [Biologics ][83]

[surgical procedure]

## [Surgical Navigation][84]

The 7D FLASH™ Navigation System revolutionizes surgical precision by combining unmatched accuracy,
efficient workflow and a reduced to completely radiation-free experience. Its machine-vision
technology rapidly captures and reconstructs a highly detailed 3D image, ensuring precise
navigation. FLASH Registration streamlines workflow, reducing patient registration time from 30
minutes to as little as 30 seconds, allowing surgeons to focus entirely on the patient rather than
cumbersome technology. With a fully sterile-field-controlled interface, the system eliminates
reliance on additional staff, enhancing surgical autonomy and efficiency. By delivering superior
accuracy with a seamless workflow, 7D FLASH Navigation empowers surgeons to operate with confidence
while prioritizing patient safety — and continues to innovate boldly, redefining the future of
surgical navigation.

[Spine Navigation System][85] | [Cranial Navigation System][86]
[7D FLASH EVD][87]

## [Therapeutic Solutions][88]

Orthofix Therapeutic Solutions are redefining recovery through a diverse, coordinated portfolio that
brings together non-invasive bone growth therapies, bracing solutions, and dedicated patient support
through a single, trusted partner. Our approach streamlines access to multiple recovery tools,
creating a more seamless experience for providers and patients. With decades of experience
supporting recovery pathways and a legacy grounded in clinical evidence, Orthofix Therapeutic
Solutions are designed to help keep patients engaged and supported throughout their healing journey.

[Bone Growth Therapies][89] | [Bracing Solutions][90]

## Corporate Responsibility

[Trees in the forest]

### Environmental Sustainability

Orthofix is committed to responsible environmental practices that include conservation of natural
resources, pollution prevention, and reduction of waste. As climate change concerns become more
prevalent, we recognize the need to comply with increased regulations and stricter environmental
standards. We believe that our focus on environmental sustainability, with the objective of reducing
costs and improving sustainability of our operations, will provide a strategic benefit.

[Learn More][91]
[diverse business team putting hands together]

### Diversity & Inclusion

Our commitment starts with attracting, retaining, and developing a workforce that is diverse in
background, knowledge, skill, and experience. We are committed to providing equal employment
opportunities, and make all recruiting, payment, performance and promotion decisions based on merit,
without discrimination on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, age, family status, ethnic
origin, nationality, disability or religious belief.

[Learn More][92]
[Social Responsibility and Community Involvement]

### Community Involvement

We don’t just make a difference in the lives of patients and their families; we make a difference in
our communities. Through our employees, Orthofix contributes hundreds of hours in hands-on
assistance and resources to philanthropic organizations around the world in addition to donations,
fundraising efforts and local community development.

[Learn More][93]

products that meet international standards. Our experienced engineering team continuously develops

[influential][15] design accolades, one of the highest achievements in design. A' Design Award

Enter Your Work

A' Design Award, recognizing the excellent and original design work from across the globe, is one of
the highest achievements in design, a source of inspiration for award-winning designers, artists,
architects, brands and design agencies. Entry and nomination is open to all from all countries.

[A' Design Award Registration][16]
Winners' Showcase

A' Design Award presents you with the World’s best design work at the A' Design Award Winners'

products, projects and services inspire and advance our society.

widely regarded as one of the most exclusive social events in design industry, and is considered to
be the design industry's premier annual red-carpet event. The A' Design Award Gala is attended by
personalities from the arts, fashion, high-society, film, architecture, industry and design media.

acknowledge and distinguish good design in all its forms.

[Design Award Jury][20]
Got Good Design?

it is not yet ready? How could you improve your design presentation to affect press members, design
buyers and design lovers? A' Design Awards offers you a free of charge, obligation-free,
confidential service called “Preliminary Checks” allowing you to get a Design Score and learn how
good your design is, and how to improve its presentation.

[Design Prize][23]
Award Categories

Any artifact, creation, art work, product, project or service that involves good design, enhanced
aesthetics, creative ideation, design thinking, superior engineering, and/or original innovation
could be nominated for A' Design Award. Entries are accepted for stand-alone works as well as
collections and product families. There are also very special design award categories for
recognizing lifelong achievements of brands, design agencies and individuals.

[Design Award Categories][24]
Trophy

Omega Particle, the A' Design Award Trophy, designed in Italy, is a tangible and durable reminder of
design excellence achievement, and serves as recognition and evidence of merit for good design. The
A' Design Award Trophy, granted to eligible laureates, is coveted by designers, artists and
architects worldwide.

[Design Award Trophy]
Omega Particle : **[A' Design Award Trophy][25]**
[Trophy of Design Awards]
[Design Trophy]
[Design Award Trophies]
[Design Trophy Packaging]
Press Room

A' Design Award's Press Room grants prominent press members and leading journalists access to high
resolution images and electronic press kits of the World’s best art works, products, designs and
architecture. Accredited editors will also be able to access profile and portrait images of
award-winning designers, logos of award-winning brands as well as exclusive interviews with
designers regarding their design philosophy and their award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][26]
Mission, Vision & Action

A' Design Award and Competition was established to create a global appreciation and awareness for
good design as well as to promote good design practices and principles worldwide. The ultimate aim
of the design accolade is to make the World a better place by promoting, publishing and advertising
good designs in all industries. A' Design Award incentivizes designers, agencies and companies
worldwide to come up with superior products, projects and services that benefit society by annually
recognizing, awarding and celebrating the very best design work from across the globe, consequently
channeling attention of press members, design media, design oriented audiences, distributors and
buyers to award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][27]
Get Involved

Connect, network and reach out to the World’s leading designers, artists, architects and
design-oriented brands and institutions by getting involved with A’ Design Award. There are many
ways to connect and collaborate, including but not limited to design award sponsorship, good design
patronage, jury membership and good design activism.

[Get Involved With A' Design Award][28]
Winners’ Kit

A' Design Award winner kit includes everything laureates need for promoting, publicizing and
advertising their award-winning products, projects and services. Winners’ Kit includes the design
award logo, yearbook inclusion, certificate, trophy, gala invitation, exhibition space, design
rankings inclusion, business networking opportunities, promotion and public relations services for
the award-winning design.

[Design Award Winners Kit]
Winners Kit : **[Design Prize][29]**
[Design Award Yearbook]
[Design Award Winner Flag]
[Design Award Bag]
[Award for Good Design]
Get Support

A' Design Award & Competition is pleased to provide you with all the support you need for taking
part in the accolade, starting with clear guidelines on how you should prepare your nomination;
standardized presentations are required to ensure all entries are voted on equal grounds. Learn how
to benefit from complimentary preliminary score and presentation improvement services, made
available to all participants without any fees.

[Get Support][30]
Big In-Numbers

Billions of Impressions, Tens of Millions of Pageviews, Tens of Thousands of Registrations, Tens of
Thousands of Project Submissions, Thousands of Eliminated Projects, Thousands of Award Winners,
Hundreds of Judges, 110+ Categories, 40+ Languages, 17 Years..

[See Big Numbers][31]
Summary

TL;DR : One of the World’s largest design accolades recognizing and promoting good design. Highest
achievement in design, extremely prestigious thanks to grand award jury, blind peer-review process,
ethical evaluation methodology and the design prize. Entries open right now for brands and
individuals.

[Register and Enter Work][32]
Learn More

A' Design Award and Competition has thousands of pages providing in-depth notes, clarifications and
documentation for participating in the design competition, about the design prize and the accolade
in general. Enter the A' Design Award knowledge base and information portal to find everything you
could potentially need to know about the design award before, during or after taking part. Access
frequently asked questions, award methodology, voting mechanism, presentation guidelines and other
content detailing each and every step of design award participation, evaluation and celebration.

[Design Award Information][33]
Featured Competition

The **Future Kitchen Design Awards**, presented by **BOTINKIT** in collaboration with the **A'
Design Award**, invites visionary designers worldwide to reimagine cooking and kitchen spaces
through groundbreaking technology and intelligent design. This prestigious competition seeks
innovative solutions that fuse artificial intelligence, robotics, and human-centric functionality,
transforming traditional culinary methods into seamless digital experiences. Participants have the
opportunity to showcase their creativity across diverse categories, including product design,
architecture, digital interfaces, and innovative service models, with the chance to win cash prizes,
international recognition, exhibition opportunities, and potential internships, all aligning with
BOTINKIT’s mission of shaping the kitchens of tomorrow.

> Extremely friendly, professional at all times and they understand the needs and wants of each role

## [ NEWS: Dr. Neel Anand Appointed President of The Society for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
## (SMISS) ][50]

The Anand Spine Group is excited to announce that renowned spine surgeon Dr. Neel Anand, Professor
of Orthopaedic Surgery and Neurosurgery and Medical Director of the Department of Orthopaedic
Surgery and Neurosurgery at Cedars Sinai Medical Center at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los
Angeles, has been appointed President of The Society for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery (SMISS)
for the 2025–2026 term.

[ Click here to learn more ][51]

## [ STUDY: Segmental Interbody, Muscle-Preserving, Ligamentotaxis-Enabled Reduction: “SIMPLER”
## Technique for cMIS Correction of ASD ][52]

Correction of adult spinal deformity (ASD) through minimally invasive techniques is a challenging
endeavor and has typically been reserved for experienced surgeons. This publication aims to be the
first high-resolution technique guide to demonstrate a reproducible technique for ASD correction
utilizing circumferential minimally invasive surgery (cMIS) without an osteotomy. The Segmental
Interbody, Muscle-Preserving, Ligamentotaxis-Enabled Reduction (SIMPLER) technique is a novel
ligamentotaxis-based scoliosis surgery that represents a paradigm shift from traditional osteotomies
toward patient-specific correction.

[ Click here to learn more ][53]
[ [A blue word that says latest news.] ][54]

The Anand Spine Group takes great pride in sharing the latest [news][56] in minimally invasive spine
surgery. Dr. Anand has been on multiple medias over the years talking about latest technology and
techniques in spine surgery. He is considered the expert in minimally invasive spine care and is
leading the way in minimally invasive spine deformity correction. He loves to educate and provide
the latest up to date technology that is available.

# FREMISS

It is through the Foundation for Research and Education in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
(FREMISS) that global aid is provided. The FREMISS Global Aid program is designed to benefit not
only surgeons, but also patients in under privileged regions of the world. With your support, we can
expand our research, strengthen our programs and improve the future of spinal care to patients
around the world.

Additionally, FREMISS supports several educational opportunities for spine surgeons. The
[Comprehensive Minimally Invasive & Outpatient Spine Surgery Fellowship][62] is an academic
experience offered to spine surgeons who desire to train in minimally invasive techniques with Dr.
Anand and conduct research. Upon graduation, fellows are encouraged to take their knowledge into
various communities around the country. The [Visiting Surgeon Program][63] welcomes spine surgeons
from around the world to spend time with Dr. Anand in clinic and in the operating room to better
understand the philosophy and application of minimally invasive and outpatient techniques.   

Thank you for your generosity which allows us to continue our mission.

## [ NEWS: Dr. Neel Anand Appointed President of The Society for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
## (SMISS) ][50]

The Anand Spine Group is excited to announce that renowned spine surgeon Dr. Neel Anand, Professor
of Orthopaedic Surgery and Neurosurgery and Medical Director of the Department of Orthopaedic
Surgery and Neurosurgery at Cedars Sinai Medical Center at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los
Angeles, has been appointed President of The Society for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery (SMISS)
for the 2025–2026 term.

[ Click here to learn more ][51]

## [ STUDY: Segmental Interbody, Muscle-Preserving, Ligamentotaxis-Enabled Reduction: “SIMPLER”
## Technique for cMIS Correction of ASD ][52]

Correction of adult spinal deformity (ASD) through minimally invasive techniques is a challenging
endeavor and has typically been reserved for experienced surgeons. This publication aims to be the
first high-resolution technique guide to demonstrate a reproducible technique for ASD correction
utilizing circumferential minimally invasive surgery (cMIS) without an osteotomy. The Segmental
Interbody, Muscle-Preserving, Ligamentotaxis-Enabled Reduction (SIMPLER) technique is a novel
ligamentotaxis-based scoliosis surgery that represents a paradigm shift from traditional osteotomies
toward patient-specific correction.

[ Click here to learn more ][53]
[ [A blue word that says latest news.] ][54]

The Anand Spine Group takes great pride in sharing the latest [news][56] in minimally invasive spine
surgery. Dr. Anand has been on multiple medias over the years talking about latest technology and
techniques in spine surgery. He is considered the expert in minimally invasive spine care and is
leading the way in minimally invasive spine deformity correction. He loves to educate and provide
the latest up to date technology that is available.

# FREMISS

It is through the Foundation for Research and Education in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
(FREMISS) that global aid is provided. The FREMISS Global Aid program is designed to benefit not
only surgeons, but also patients in under privileged regions of the world. With your support, we can
expand our research, strengthen our programs and improve the future of spinal care to patients
around the world.

Additionally, FREMISS supports several educational opportunities for spine surgeons. The
[Comprehensive Minimally Invasive & Outpatient Spine Surgery Fellowship][62] is an academic
experience offered to spine surgeons who desire to train in minimally invasive techniques with Dr.
Anand and conduct research. Upon graduation, fellows are encouraged to take their knowledge into
various communities around the country. The [Visiting Surgeon Program][63] welcomes spine surgeons
from around the world to spend time with Dr. Anand in clinic and in the operating room to better
understand the philosophy and application of minimally invasive and outpatient techniques.   

Thank you for your generosity which allows us to continue our mission.

## We are Meril. We are committed to addressing unmet clinical needs around the world through our 
## innovative and path-breaking medical devices.

Consciously contributing to alleviate ailments, we partner with the global medical fraternity across
various specialties.

## Founded in 2006

Meril is an India-based, global medical device company that is dedicated to design and manufacture
clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

## Our Purpose

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,
including cardiovascular, orthopedics, robotics, diagnostics, and oncology, aimed at alleviating
human suffering.

## Arthroscopic Surgery

### Minimally Invasive Procedure

Arthroscopy is a minimally invasive surgical procedure in which an arthroscope, a small, soft,
flexible tube with a light and video camera at the end, is inserted into the joint to evaluate and
treat a variety of conditions
* [Know More][167]
* [Watch Video][168]

## Non-Surgical Procedures

### Platelet-rich Plasma Injection

PRP injection is a nonsurgical procedure that involves using a patient's own blood platelets to heal
damage in joints and surrounding tissues, including muscles, ligaments, tendons, and cartilage

* [Watch Video][170]

## Arthroscopic Surgery

### Minimally Invasive Procedure

Arthroscopy is a minimally invasive surgical procedure in which an arthroscope, a small, soft,
flexible tube with a light and video camera at the end, is inserted into the joint to evaluate and
treat a variety of conditions
* [Know More][167]

## Non-Surgical Procedures

### Platelet-rich Plasma Injection

PRP injection is a nonsurgical procedure that involves using a patient's own blood platelets to heal
damage in joints and surrounding tissues, including muscles, ligaments, tendons, and cartilage

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

# Living with back
# or neck pain?

# You’re not alone.

Whether you’re newly diagnosed or managing chronic pain, SpineHealth.org provides **[expert-reviewed
information][139]** and a **[supportive community][140]** to help you move forward with confidence.
[ Understand Your Pain ][141]
[ Explore Spine Anatomy ][142]

# Join events that move spine health forward

From global conferences to virtual learning, explore upcoming events shaping the future of spinal
research and treatement.

[ Upcoming Events ][143]

# Help others find answers, support
# and hope

Millions of people experience neck and back pain each year. Your donation helps provide trusted
information, amplify patient voices, and grow a supportive community for those navigating spine
conditions. 
[**Learn how your support helps.**][144]

[ Donate Today ][145]

###### ANSWERS, TREATMENT OPTIONS AND SUPPORT

## How can we help you?

Connect with people who understand what you’re going through.

[ Find Your Way Forward ][154]

###### Start with the Basics

## Understand your spine

Click on a region of the spine to explore conditions, treatments, and recovery stories specific to
your area of concern.

Cervical
Thoracic
Lumbar
Sacral

### Cervical Spine

Vertebrae C1 – C7 — common conditions in this region:

#### [ Herniated Disc ][155]

#### [ Cervical Stenosis ][156]

#### [ Whiplash ][157]

#### [ Degenerative Disc Disease ][158]

### Thoracic Spine

Vertebrae T1 – T12 — common conditions in this region:

#### [ Scoliosis ][159]

#### [ Kyphosis ][160]

#### [ Compression Fracture ][161]

#### [ Thoracic Disc Herniation ][162]

### Lumbar Spine

Vertebrae L1 – L5 — common conditions in this region:

#### [ Sciatica ][163]

#### [ Lumbar Stenosis ][164]

#### [ Spondylolisthesis ][165]

#### [ Degenerative Disc Disease ][166]

### Sacral Spine

Vertebrae S1 – S5 — common conditions in this region:

#### [ Sacroiliac Joint Dysfunction ][167]

#### [ Coccydynia ][168]

#### [ Sacral Fracture ][169]

[ Learn More Spine Basics ][170]

###### You're Not Alone

## Connect with others who understand

Hear from people who have faced similar challenges, and connect with a community built on shared
experiences, support, and hope. From diagnosis to recovery, these stories offer insight,
encouragement, and a reminder that you’re not alone.

Patient Story

#### [Dancing Through Scoliosis][171]

From a young ballet dancer diagnosed with scoliosis to a professional performer on some of the
world’s biggest stages, Meredith’s story is a powerful testament to resilience, determination, and
the strength to keep moving forward.

[ Read More Patient Stories ][172]
[ Meet Our Advocates ][173]

Patient Story

#### [From Service to Strength][174]

After years of living with worsening neck pain and nerve symptoms, Jonathan found relief through
cervical spine surgery and is steadily returning to military service, endurance sports, and the life
he loves.

Advocate Profile

#### [Making Waves After Spine Surgery][175]

After multiple spine surgeries, including two spinal fusions, Mary refused to let scoliosis define
her. Today, she is an aquatic therapist, instructor, and Spinal Champion who helps others recover
through movement, proving that resilience can turn life’s greatest challenges into purpose.

Access professional-grade resources, research data, and CME content designed specifically for spine
care providers.

encouragement, and a reminder that you’re not alone.

Patient Story

#### [Dancing Through Scoliosis][171]

From a young ballet dancer diagnosed with scoliosis to a professional performer on some of the
world’s biggest stages, Meredith’s story is a powerful testament to resilience, determination, and
the strength to keep moving forward.

[ Read More Patient Stories ][172]

Patient Story

#### [From Service to Strength][174]

After years of living with worsening neck pain and nerve symptoms, Jonathan found relief through
cervical spine surgery and is steadily returning to military service, endurance sports, and the life
he loves.

Advocate Profile

#### [Making Waves After Spine Surgery][175]

After multiple spine surgeries, including two spinal fusions, Mary refused to let scoliosis define
her. Today, she is an aquatic therapist, instructor, and Spinal Champion who helps others recover
through movement, proving that resilience can turn life’s greatest challenges into purpose.

# **VSI® – The Premier Spine Center**

VSI has been a trusted leader in spine care since 1992, serving as your reliable partner in spinal
health. Founded in Reston, Virginia, as a private medical center at the forefront of advanced spine
restoration, we offer personalized treatments for neck and back pain, as well as other spine and
orthopedic conditions.

Patients turn to VSI seeking pain relief, searching for new treatment options, surgical
consultations or looking for a second opinion. Their common goal is clear – to reclaim their lives.
At VSI, our team of specialists brings decades of advanced medical expertise and utilizes modern
technology to deliver desirable patient outcomes.

# **VSI® – The Premier Spine Center**

VSI has been a trusted leader in spine care since 1992, serving as your reliable partner in spinal
health. Founded in Reston, Virginia, as a private medical center at the forefront of advanced spine
restoration, we offer personalized treatments for neck and back pain, as well as other spine and
orthopedic conditions.

Patients turn to VSI seeking pain relief, searching for new treatment options, surgical
consultations or looking for a second opinion. Their common goal is clear – to reclaim their lives.
At VSI, our team of specialists brings decades of advanced medical expertise and utilizes modern
technology to deliver desirable patient outcomes.

The biomechanical principle of the dynamic stabilisation of the lumbar spine consists in the control
of uncoordinated and thus painful relative movements between vertebral bodies.

**[FIND OUT MORE >][54]**

1

successfully been used in long-term implants for 25 years.

system’s dynamic prospects and long-term implantation time.

## Spineway designs innovative technologies for spinal surgery

][38]

Spineway is an independent French company, founded in Lyon in 2005, specializing in the design and
development of innovative technologies for spine surgery. By combining French expertise with an
international network, we have seized major growth opportunities with the acquisitions of Distimp in
2021 and Spine Innovations in 2022. These integrations have enable us to broaden our offering by
combining complementary product portfolios and territories, while proposing innovative solutions to
treat new pathologies. Much more than just a manufacturer, we are committed to our surgeon partners.
We offer a global program of customized training courses in surgical techniques, tailored to meet
the specific needs of practitioners.

Discover more

> "Together, all the way"

Spineway Group
Our mission

## Spineway Academy

Our medical education department is dedicated to provide healthcare professionals at all levels of
expertise with continuous and dedicated educational training programs, as well as scientific
content, on our advanced treatments for cervical and thoracolumbar spinal diseases.

[icone OR Training]

### OR Training

Reinforcement of existing skills & knowledge in an interactive environment through discussions &
technical procedures in the OR

[icone Hands-on Courses]

### Hands-on Courses

Reinforcement of existing skills &knowledge in an interactive environment through training on
anatomical models.

[icone Webinars]

### Webinars

Advanced virtual course to compare operative procedures, fundamental concepts in a clinical
environment

[icone Meet the expert]

### Meet the expert

Focus on one topic or specific technology, discuss & compare operative techniques and cases in a
clinical environment

## Spineway designs innovative technologies for spinal surgery

][38]

Spineway is an independent French company, founded in Lyon in 2005, specializing in the design and
development of innovative technologies for spine surgery. By combining French expertise with an
international network, we have seized major growth opportunities with the acquisitions of Distimp in
2021 and Spine Innovations in 2022. These integrations have enable us to broaden our offering by
combining complementary product portfolios and territories, while proposing innovative solutions to
treat new pathologies. Much more than just a manufacturer, we are committed to our surgeon partners.
We offer a global program of customized training courses in surgical techniques, tailored to meet
the specific needs of practitioners.

Discover more

> "Together, all the way"

Spineway Group
Our mission

expertise with continuous and dedicated educational training programs, as well as scientific
content, on our advanced treatments for cervical and thoracolumbar spinal diseases.

# Patient Experiences**
# **

Dr. Smalley is one of the absolutely best orthopedic specialist we have in the Chattanooga area. My
husband saw him after a work-related injury. Dr. Smally sent him for scans, quickly diagnosed a torn
labrum and suggested surgery to repair his shoulder. They were quick to set up his surgery at Center
for Sports Medicine Surgery Center. We are thankful for Dr. Smalley, his staff and the care they
provided! Although we hope to never need an orthopedic again, if we did, we would not consider
anyone else! We would HIGHLY RECOMMEND him!

Amber

I have been to Center for Sports Medicine too many times to count. I saw Dr. Nash for my knee
replacement, and I have always liked the medical professionals I have seen there, and I trust them
with my care. While I wish I hadn’t needed all the surgeries I’ve had, I am grateful for the
excellent care I received. I should also add that ALL of their staff at every one of their several
branches is friendly, efficient, and professional. How remarkable is that?

Allison

I am SO THANKFUL for being able to move with far less pain and touch my toes 9 days following
surgery! Thank you, Dr. Shay Richardson, for the beautiful gift of mobility and flexibility you’ve
given back to me.

Deb

The entire staff (surgeon, PA, nurses, office support) have seen to all of our needs. They have been
extremely professional, knowledgeable and served us with a great attitude. In fac, they have gone
way above to help us get everything in line for my husband’s emergency surgery. We highly recommend
Dr. Jason Rogers and his staff!

Dorna

Dr. Mitchell is GREAT! Very understanding of the needs/wants of a student athlete. Thank you for
taking the time to care to explain what needs to be done to my son while recovering from his injury.

Christopher

Dr. Robertson and his office has been phenomenal! I walked into the clinic, and they squeezed me
into their very busy Monday morning schedule. They took into consideration what my insurance would
cover before ordering anything, and graciously took time to answer my questions. Dr. Robertson
performed a thorough exam even though my injury was pretty straightforward. I will definitely be
recommending his office for any orthopedic needs!

Rebekah

I saw Dr. Smith and Chris Massey for treatment of my broken arm and nerve damage. Both of them were
incredible professionals and total experts in their craft. I was blown away by how they took a
really unfortunate accident and turned it into the best experience you could expect for a surgery
and recovery.

Steven

I needed shoulder surgery for anterior and posterior labrum tears and went to see Dr. Sanders. He
and his staff, the surgery staff and all the physical therapy staff are excellent! He clearly mapped
out the surgery to recovery to rehab process. My chronic shoulder and neck pains are gone!

Eric

Dr. Spangler has been a wonderful surgeon! With each appointment, he has always taken his time. I
have never felt rushed or like I was just “another patient.” He quickly diagnosed my problem and fit
me into his surgery schedule! The front office staff, his nurse, and his scheduler are all very nice
and polite as well!

Ashley

# Patient Experiences**
# **

Dr. Smalley is one of the absolutely best orthopedic specialist we have in the Chattanooga area. My
husband saw him after a work-related injury. Dr. Smally sent him for scans, quickly diagnosed a torn
labrum and suggested surgery to repair his shoulder. They were quick to set up his surgery at Center
for Sports Medicine Surgery Center. We are thankful for Dr. Smalley, his staff and the care they
provided! Although we hope to never need an orthopedic again, if we did, we would not consider
anyone else! We would HIGHLY RECOMMEND him!

Amber

I have been to Center for Sports Medicine too many times to count. I saw Dr. Nash for my knee
replacement, and I have always liked the medical professionals I have seen there, and I trust them
with my care. While I wish I hadn’t needed all the surgeries I’ve had, I am grateful for the
excellent care I received. I should also add that ALL of their staff at every one of their several
branches is friendly, efficient, and professional. How remarkable is that?

Allison

I am SO THANKFUL for being able to move with far less pain and touch my toes 9 days following
surgery! Thank you, Dr. Shay Richardson, for the beautiful gift of mobility and flexibility you’ve
given back to me.

Deb

The entire staff (surgeon, PA, nurses, office support) have seen to all of our needs. They have been
extremely professional, knowledgeable and served us with a great attitude. In fac, they have gone
way above to help us get everything in line for my husband’s emergency surgery. We highly recommend
Dr. Jason Rogers and his staff!

Dorna

Dr. Mitchell is GREAT! Very understanding of the needs/wants of a student athlete. Thank you for
taking the time to care to explain what needs to be done to my son while recovering from his injury.

Christopher

Dr. Robertson and his office has been phenomenal! I walked into the clinic, and they squeezed me
into their very busy Monday morning schedule. They took into consideration what my insurance would
cover before ordering anything, and graciously took time to answer my questions. Dr. Robertson
performed a thorough exam even though my injury was pretty straightforward. I will definitely be
recommending his office for any orthopedic needs!

Rebekah

I saw Dr. Smith and Chris Massey for treatment of my broken arm and nerve damage. Both of them were
incredible professionals and total experts in their craft. I was blown away by how they took a
really unfortunate accident and turned it into the best experience you could expect for a surgery
and recovery.

Steven

I needed shoulder surgery for anterior and posterior labrum tears and went to see Dr. Sanders. He
and his staff, the surgery staff and all the physical therapy staff are excellent! He clearly mapped
out the surgery to recovery to rehab process. My chronic shoulder and neck pains are gone!

Eric

Dr. Spangler has been a wonderful surgeon! With each appointment, he has always taken his time. I
have never felt rushed or like I was just “another patient.” He quickly diagnosed my problem and fit
me into his surgery schedule! The front office staff, his nurse, and his scheduler are all very nice
and polite as well!

Ashley

## Who We Are

We are a medical device company focused on improving the quality of life for patients undergoing
spine surgery. We develop motion-preserving technologies designed to treat degenerative disc disease
while supporting the spine’s natural curvature.

Our flagship product, the FDA-approved Synergy Disc^{®}, features a built-in 6-degree lordotic core
designed to not only preserve motion but also improve sagittal alignment.

[Learn more About Us][29]

## Synergy Disc

The Synergy Disc is the first and only artificial cervical disc designed to improve alignment and
provide intentional motion preservation, using time-tested and trusted materials.

[Synergy Disc]The Synergy Disc is commercially available in the United States, the United Kingdom,
Europe, Australia, Canada (SAP), South Africa, and Malaysia.

## Who We Are

We are a medical device company focused on improving the quality of life for patients undergoing
spine surgery. We develop motion-preserving technologies designed to treat degenerative disc disease
while supporting the spine’s natural curvature.

Our flagship product, the FDA-approved Synergy Disc^{®}, features a built-in 6-degree lordotic core
designed to not only preserve motion but also improve sagittal alignment.

[Learn more About Us][29]

## Synergy Disc

The Synergy Disc is the first and only artificial cervical disc designed to improve alignment and
provide intentional motion preservation, using time-tested and trusted materials.

[Learn More about Synergy Disc][30]
[Synergy Disc]The Synergy Disc is commercially available in the United States, the United Kingdom,
Europe, Australia, Canada (SAP), South Africa, and Malaysia.

## Upgraded and optimized version of Borland Turbo C++

**Turbo C++** is a **modified version of the classic Borland Turbo C++** integrated
[development][185] environment, specifically optimized to **run on modern Windows operating
systems**. The original DOS-based software was a favorite for many programmers, but it became
incompatible with newer versions of Windows. This program was **developed to bridge that gap**.

### Top Recommended Alternative

### Dev-C++

][186]

Turbo C++ offers **a reliable solution **for those who miss the classic C programming environment.
It **uses an emulator to create a virtual DOS machine**, allowing it to run smoothly on Windows
Vista, 7, 8, and newer versions. **Designed to be simple**, it makes the setup process easier than
manual installation.

### A better program

Turbo C++ **retains all the beloved features** of its predecessor, including the compiler, debugger,
and the ability to set breakpoints. It also comes with **additional tools, such as code inspection
and tracing**. A significant advantage is that this modified version **is compatible with both
32-bit and 64-bit operating systems**, a crucial feature for modern computers. It even **includes
example programs** to help new users get started.

Beyond its core functionality, the program offers **enhanced stability** by running within an
emulated environment. This **helps eliminate many of the compatibility problems **found in other
methods of running DOS-based software on a modern Windows system. Its **ability to run in both a
windowed and a full-screen mode** also adds to the user's convenience, mimicking the original
experience for easier familiarization.

However, despite its improvements, the program is not without its issues. **Certain keyboard
shortcuts can malfunction **depending on the user’s keyboard layout, especially on Windows 8, and
**some users have reported issues with laptop multimedia drivers**. The program **still requires a
few manual code adjustments** to function properly and **may require a clean re-installation to
avoid issues**, which can be a hassle.

### Historical significance of the original IDE

Turbo C++, originally developed by Borland, played a crucial role in popularizing C and C++
programming during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Its **fast compilation speed, integrated
debugging tools, and user-friendly interface** made it a staple in both academic and professional
environments.

### Emulation technology and DOS compatibility

Modern versions of Turbo C++ rely on **DOS emulation layers**,** **commonly through tools like
DOSBox, to recreate the **legacy DOS environment**. This approach ensures better compatibility with
**64-bit Windows systems**, where native DOS support has been completely removed, improving
stability compared to older workaround methods.

### Educational relevance in modern times

Despite being outdated, Turbo C++ continues to be used in **educational institutions**, especially
in regions where **legacy curricula** still emphasize foundational programming. Its **simple
interface and minimal system requirements** make it ideal for beginners learning basic syntax, logic
building, and structured programming concepts.

### Limitations with modern C++ standards

One of the biggest drawbacks is its** lack of support for modern C++ standards** such as C++11 and
beyond. This means developers cannot utilize **advanced features like auto typing, smart pointers,
or modern libraries**, making it unsuitable for professional or large-scale software development in
today’s programming landscape.

### Alternatives and modern IDE options

While Turbo C++ remains useful for nostalgia and learning, many developers now prefer modern tools
like Code::Blocks, Dev-C++, or Visual Studio Code. These alternatives offer full support for modern
compilers, extensions, debugging tools, and cross-platform development, making them more practical
for current use cases.

### Community support and continued usage

Although no longer officially maintained, Turbo C++ benefits from **community-driven support**,
including **guides, patches, and troubleshooting fixes** shared across forums and educational sites.
This ongoing support helps keep the software usable, even as operating systems continue to evolve.

### An essential tool

In conclusion, Turbo C++ is a valuable tool for fans of the original IDE and students learning
C/C++. It brings a classic programming environment into the modern era with enhanced stability and a
simple installation. While it still has some lingering bugs and requires minor user intervention, it
remains a reliable and highly convenient option for anyone looking to use this classic software.

## Upgraded and optimized version of Borland Turbo C++

**Turbo C++** is a **modified version of the classic Borland Turbo C++** integrated
[development][185] environment, specifically optimized to **run on modern Windows operating
systems**. The original DOS-based software was a favorite for many programmers, but it became
incompatible with newer versions of Windows. This program was **developed to bridge that gap**.

### Top Recommended Alternative

[[Dev-C++ icon]

### Dev-C++

Free

4
][186]

Turbo C++ offers **a reliable solution **for those who miss the classic C programming environment.
It **uses an emulator to create a virtual DOS machine**, allowing it to run smoothly on Windows
Vista, 7, 8, and newer versions. **Designed to be simple**, it makes the setup process easier than
manual installation.

### A better program

Turbo C++ **retains all the beloved features** of its predecessor, including the compiler, debugger,
and the ability to set breakpoints. It also comes with **additional tools, such as code inspection
and tracing**. A significant advantage is that this modified version **is compatible with both
32-bit and 64-bit operating systems**, a crucial feature for modern computers. It even **includes
example programs** to help new users get started.

Beyond its core functionality, the program offers **enhanced stability** by running within an
emulated environment. This **helps eliminate many of the compatibility problems **found in other
methods of running DOS-based software on a modern Windows system. Its **ability to run in both a
windowed and a full-screen mode** also adds to the user's convenience, mimicking the original
experience for easier familiarization.

However, despite its improvements, the program is not without its issues. **Certain keyboard
shortcuts can malfunction **depending on the user’s keyboard layout, especially on Windows 8, and
**some users have reported issues with laptop multimedia drivers**. The program **still requires a
few manual code adjustments** to function properly and **may require a clean re-installation to
avoid issues**, which can be a hassle.

### Historical significance of the original IDE

Turbo C++, originally developed by Borland, played a crucial role in popularizing C and C++
programming during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Its **fast compilation speed, integrated
debugging tools, and user-friendly interface** made it a staple in both academic and professional
environments.

### Emulation technology and DOS compatibility

Modern versions of Turbo C++ rely on **DOS emulation layers**,** **commonly through tools like
DOSBox, to recreate the **legacy DOS environment**. This approach ensures better compatibility with
**64-bit Windows systems**, where native DOS support has been completely removed, improving
stability compared to older workaround methods.

### Educational relevance in modern times

Despite being outdated, Turbo C++ continues to be used in **educational institutions**, especially
in regions where **legacy curricula** still emphasize foundational programming. Its **simple
interface and minimal system requirements** make it ideal for beginners learning basic syntax, logic
building, and structured programming concepts.

### Limitations with modern C++ standards

One of the biggest drawbacks is its** lack of support for modern C++ standards** such as C++11 and
beyond. This means developers cannot utilize **advanced features like auto typing, smart pointers,
or modern libraries**, making it unsuitable for professional or large-scale software development in
today’s programming landscape.

### Alternatives and modern IDE options

While Turbo C++ remains useful for nostalgia and learning, many developers now prefer modern tools
like Code::Blocks, Dev-C++, or Visual Studio Code. These alternatives offer full support for modern
compilers, extensions, debugging tools, and cross-platform development, making them more practical
for current use cases.

### Community support and continued usage

Although no longer officially maintained, Turbo C++ benefits from **community-driven support**,
including **guides, patches, and troubleshooting fixes** shared across forums and educational sites.
This ongoing support helps keep the software usable, even as operating systems continue to evolve.

### An essential tool

In conclusion, Turbo C++ is a valuable tool for fans of the original IDE and students learning
C/C++. It brings a classic programming environment into the modern era with enhanced stability and a
simple installation. While it still has some lingering bugs and requires minor user intervention, it
remains a reliable and highly convenient option for anyone looking to use this classic software.
